description: This file defines the FavoritesFragment class, which displays a list of favorite items in a grid layout. It manages UI components such as RecyclerView and TextView, observes a ViewModel for data changes, and handles navigation to a details screen.

classes.name: FavoritesFragment
classes.description: Fragment class that displays and manages the list of favorite items.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes views, sets up RecyclerView, adapter, and observes favorites data to update UI.
